_readme: words: the target sentence, tokenised. What the child was ASKED to read.
expert_correct: one boolean per word. Did Christine or Sophie judge that the
child actually read it? This is the ground truth and everything depends on
it. Get two experts to label independently and check they agree before you
trust any result - if the humans disagree, no tool can be judged.
phonemes: optional. Leave it out and espeak-ng generates them, which is what
you want, because the model was fine-tuned on espeak output. Only override
when espeak is wrong about a specific word.
precomputed: per-WORD scores you already have from Azure and SpeechAce.
